item.title: Pete Buttigieg Breaks Silence on Shocking Hoax Targeting His Family
item.description:
Imagine being briefly separated from your own children because an anonymous stranger told authorities you were a danger to them. That is exactly what happened to Pete Buttigieg, and his decision to speak out is reshaping the conversation around his political future.

The former Transportation Secretary—and a leading potential 2028 Democratic presidential contender—just revealed one of the most disturbing episodes of his public life. And he is, in his own words, “beyond furious.”

item.title: Mike Pence's Surprising Break: Why He's Challenging Trump's Second Term
item.description:
Mike Pence’s Surprising Break: Why He’s Challenging Trump’s Second Term

What happens when a former vice president publicly tells his own party they’ve “lost their way”? That’s exactly the political earthquake unfolding right now, as Mike Pence delivers his sharpest critique yet of the second Trump administration. The man once mocked as the loyalest soldier in MAGA has stepped into an unexpected role: the conservative conscience of a party drifting from its own roots.

item.title: Todd Blanche's Bold DOJ Audition: What's Really Happening
item.description:
Todd Blanche’s Bold DOJ Audition: What’s Really Happening

Imagine being told your new job is technically temporary — but the boss calls it an audition. That’s the position Todd Blanche finds himself in right now, and he’s not playing it safe. In just weeks since stepping in as Acting Attorney General, the former personal attorney to President Donald Trump has launched a flurry of headline-grabbing moves at the Department of Justice.

item.title: Every Major Act Dominating Congress This Week
item.description:
Ten different bills with “Act” in the name hit major headlines in a single week. That’s not a coincidence — it’s a signal that Washington is moving faster, louder, and messier than at any point in recent memory.

Whether it’s a sweeping constitutional check on executive power or a Senate hearing over boxing reforms, the word Act is doing heavy lifting across American news this week. Here’s what’s actually happening, stripped of the spin.
